keyEvents.text: Goal! Le Havre 0, Lorient 1. Isaak Touré (Lorient) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Arsène Kouassi.
Delay in match because of an injury Mbwana Samatta (Le Havre).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Arthur Avom (Lorient).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Le Havre 0, Lorient 1.
Substitution, Le Havre. Amir Richardson replaces Mbwana Samatta.
Second Half begins Le Havre 0, Lorient 1.
Substitution, Lorient. Mamadou Koné replaces Aiyegun Tosin.
Substitution, Lorient. Souleymane Faye replaces Gabin Bernardeau.
Souleymane Faye (Lorient) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Isaak Touré (Lorient).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lorient. Nosa Obaretin replaces Isaak Touré because of an injury.
Substitution, Le Havre. Ismaïl Bouneb replaces Kaito Mizuta.
Substitution, Le Havre. Lamine N'Diaye replaces Enzo Koffi.
Delay in match because of an injury Junior Mwanga (Le Havre).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Le Havre. Hakim Dongopandji replaces Rayan Fofana.
Substitution, Le Havre. Daren Mosengo replaces Junior Mwanga because of an injury.
Noah Cadiou (Lorient) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Le Havre 0, Lorient 2. Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mamadou Koné following a fast break.
Ahmed Touba (Le Havre) is shown the yellow card.
Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Second Half ends, Le Havre 0, Lorient 2.
